ratios.quote: The Credit Agreement providing for our Revolving Credit Facility contains a minimum consolidated fixed charge coverage ratio of 1.25 to 1.00 and a maximum consolidated total net leverage ratio (the “CTNL Ratio”).

ratios.covenant_name: consolidated total net leverage ratio (CTNL Ratio)
ratios.quote: For the period from September 26, 2025 to June 26, 2026, the CTNL Ratio for any fiscal quarter may not exceed 3.75:1.00, and thereafter, the CTNL Ratio for any fiscal quarter may not exceed 3.50:1.00.

parsed.notes: The filing gives only the covenant requirements, not Varex's actual ratios. The 3.75x net leverage limit applies to quarters ending between September 26, 2025 and June 26, 2026, which covers the October 3, 2025 period end; the limit then steps down to 3.50x. Both ratios are tested on the last day of each fiscal quarter. The Revolving Credit Facility was undrawn at October 3, 2025. Leverage-based pricing grids for interest margins and fees, and the Senior Secured Notes indenture, were left out.
